name: Tapri Gang
tagline: Ek cutting chai, teen dost, full masti
about:
Tapri Gang is a desi stickman cartoon comedy about three friends who meet every day at Raju's chai tapri.

Pappu has a jugaad for everything (none of them work). Golu is the gentle foodie who believes everything he hears. Chhotu, the sharp little boy who runs the tapri, lands the final punch every single time.

Short Hindi comedy from Indian galis, kirana shops, school classrooms, rooftops and the tapri itself. Clean, family friendly, no bad words.

3 new Shorts every day: 7 AM, 12 noon and 7 PM IST.
Chai lo, comment karo, aur dosto ko tag karo jo bilkul Pappu jaisa hai.

Instagram: @taprigangcomedy
description_footer:
Tapri Gang: Pappu, Golu aur Chhotu ki desi stickman comedy.
Roz 3 naye Shorts: subah 7, dopahar 12, shaam 7 baje. Subscribe karo, chai thandi ho rahi hai!

All characters are fictional. Original animation, made with love in India.
